title: TrueNAS - Operations Center
description: Comprehensive TrueNAS dashboard: system health, CPU, memory, ZFS pools & ARC, disks, network, services, shares, apps, VMs, boot environments, hardware/IPMI, alerts, tasks, security, advanced protocols, and exporter diagnostics.

options.content:
# TrueNAS Operations Center

Comprehensive monitoring covering **system health, CPU, memory, ZFS pools & ARC, disks, network, services, shares, apps, VMs, boot environments, hardware, alerts, tasks, security posture, and exporter diagnostics**.

> **Tip:** start with the *Instance* picker, then narrow by Pool, Dataset, Disk, Service, App or API Method. Collapsed detail rows keep the default view fast.

panels.title: Exporter
panels.description: Exporter can reach the TrueNAS API.

panels.title: Alerts
panels.description: Outstanding (not dismissed) alerts: alert_count minus alert_dismissed_count. truenas_alert_count includes dismissed alerts.

panels.title: RAM no ARC
panels.description: Memory used by the OS, services, apps and VMs: used minus the ZFS ARC, as a share of physical RAM. The ARC is cache that ZFS releases under pressure, so it is excluded here.

panels.title: ARC Hit
panels.description: ZFS ARC demand-data hit rate, computed from hits/s ÷ accesses/s (the upstream hit-ratio field is unreliable on 27.0 RC.1).

panels.title: Update DL
panels.description: Update download progress; N/A when no download is running.

panels.title: CPU Usage
panels.description: Total and per-core CPU usage. Look for a single core pinned near 100 % (single-threaded bottleneck).

panels.title: Load Average
panels.description: Load average vs CPU core count. Load above core count means queueing.

panels.title: CPU Temperature per Core
panels.description: Per-core CPU temperatures. Sustained high temps indicate cooling issues.

panels.title: CPU Time Breakdown
panels.description: User/system/iowait/IRQ/idle split. TrueNAS 25.10 and 26.0 report it; 27.0 sends total usage only (NaN here), so the panel stays empty there by design (D11).

panels.title: RAM excl. ARC
panels.description: Memory used by the OS, services, apps and VMs: used minus the ZFS ARC, as a share of physical RAM. The ARC is cache that ZFS releases under pressure, so it is excluded here.

panels.title: RAM incl. ARC
panels.description: Raw 'used' share as TrueNAS reports it, including the reclaimable ZFS ARC. Informational: high values are normal on a NAS.

panels.title: Memory Capacity Over Time
panels.description: Physical memory from reporting.realtime. 'Used' includes the ZFS ARC; 'Used excl. ARC' is what services, apps and VMs hold.

panels.title: Documented ARC Memory Over Time
panels.description: ARC memory fields explicitly documented by reporting.realtime.

panels.title: Oldest Snap
panels.description: Age of the oldest snapshot. Very old snapshots may waste space.

panels.title: Days Until Full
panels.description: Linear projection of each pool's allocation trend over the last 7 days (predict_linear-style: free ÷ growth rate). Pools that are flat or shrinking show N/A. Needs a few hours of history; treat short-range estimates as rough.

panels.title: Pool Space Being Freed
panels.description: Bytes being freed by ongoing operations on TrueNAS26/27. Missing on unsupported or unavailable sources.

panels.title: Pool Utilization
panels.description: Per-pool fill ratio. Pools above 80% suffer performance degradation.

panels.title: Top Dataset Utilization
panels.description: Datasets closest to filling their available space.

panels.title: Pool Capacity Trends
panels.description: Pool allocated and free space over time for capacity planning.

panels.title: Pool Fragmentation
panels.description: Pool fragmentation over time. High fragmentation degrades performance.

panels.title: Pool Scan Progress
panels.description: Scrub/resilver progress per pool, clamped to 100 %: TrueNAS can report slightly over 100 % (e.g. 101.4) for a finished scan.

panels.title: Pool Inventory
panels.description: Pool capacity, health, dedup-table footprint, and active expansion progress.

targets.expr: 100 * max by (pool) (truenas_pool_allocated_bytes{instance=~"$instance", pool=~"$pool"}) / clamp_min(max by (pool) (truenas_pool_size_bytes{instance=~"$instance", pool=~"$pool"}), 1)

panels.title: Pool Expansion Progress
panels.description: Completion percentage for active pool expansion reflow.

panels.title: Pool Realtime I/O
panels.description: Per-pool read/write throughput from reporting.realtime. TrueNAS 27.0 sends pool capacity only; see Disk Throughput for I/O on 27.

panels.title: Snap Task Max
panels.description: Maximum number of snapshot tasks allowed.

panels.title: Scrub Enabled
panels.description: Pools with an enabled scrub task.

panels.title: Scanning Now
panels.description: Pools with an active scrub/resilver scan (0 when none is running).

panels.title: Pool Status & Scrub Detail
panels.description: Pool status enum, v26 detailed status_code, warning flag, scrub-task enablement, and time since last scan.

panels.title: Pool Scan Bytes Progress
panels.description: Bytes processed vs. total for the last/active pool scrub or resilver scan.

panels.title: Pool Realtime Capacity
panels.description: Per-pool capacity from the reporting.realtime event stream.

panels.title: Pool Scan ETA
panels.description: Estimated seconds remaining in the active pool scan.

panels.title: Pool Scan Errors
panels.description: Errors found during the last/active pool scan.

panels.title: ARC Size
panels.description: Current documented ZFS ARC cache size.

panels.title: L2ARC Hit %
panels.description: L2ARC hits/s ÷ accesses/s. N/A when there is no L2ARC device or no L2ARC traffic.

panels.title: Data Hit %
panels.description: Demand-data hits/s ÷ accesses/s (computed from rates; the upstream ratio field reads 0 on 27.0 RC.1).

panels.title: Demand Hit & Miss Rates
panels.description: Documented ARC demand-data and demand-metadata hit and miss rates.

panels.title: ARC Memory Headroom
panels.description: Documented ARC free and available memory fields.

panels.title: Demand & L2ARC Hit Ratios
panels.description: Cache hit percentages computed from hits/s ÷ accesses/s. Higher is better; gaps mean no accesses in that interval.

panels.title: Demand Data & Metadata Rates
panels.description: Demand access rates for data and metadata, including I/O-level hit rates.

panels.title: L2ARC Throughput
panels.description: L2ARC I/O. High write with low hit ratio signals cache churn.

panels.title: Hottest Disk
panels.description: Highest disk temperature. Disks reporting 0 °C (no sensor, e.g. USB bridges) are ignored.

panels.title: Avg Busy
panels.description: Average disk busy %. TrueNAS 27 reports aggregate disk I/O only; this then shows one "total" series, and per-disk filters do not apply.

targets.expr: avg((truenas_disk_busy_percent{instance=~"$instance", disk=~"$disk", disk!="total"} or (truenas_disk_busy_percent{instance=~"$instance", disk="total"} unless on (instance) truenas_disk_busy_percent{instance=~"$instance", disk!="total"})))

panels.title: Disk Throughput by Device
panels.description: Read (up) and write (down) throughput for the busiest devices. TrueNAS 27 reports aggregate disk I/O only; this then shows one "total" series, and per-disk filters do not apply.

targets.expr: topk(8, (truenas_disk_read_bytes_per_second{instance=~"$instance", disk=~"$disk", disk!="total"} or (truenas_disk_read_bytes_per_second{instance=~"$instance", disk="total"} unless on (instance) truenas_disk_read_bytes_per_second{instance=~"$instance", disk!="total"})))

-1 * topk(8, (truenas_disk_write_bytes_per_second{instance=~"$instance", disk=~"$disk", disk!="total"} or (truenas_disk_write_bytes_per_second{instance=~"$instance", disk="total"} unless on (instance) truenas_disk_write_bytes_per_second{instance=~"$instance", disk!="total"})))

panels.title: Disk IOPS by Device
panels.description: Read (up) and write (down) IOPS per device. TrueNAS 27 reports aggregate disk I/O only; this then shows one "total" series, and per-disk filters do not apply.

targets.expr: topk(8, (truenas_disk_read_ops_per_second{instance=~"$instance", disk=~"$disk", disk!="total"} or (truenas_disk_read_ops_per_second{instance=~"$instance", disk="total"} unless on (instance) truenas_disk_read_ops_per_second{instance=~"$instance", disk!="total"})))

-1 * topk(8, (truenas_disk_write_ops_per_second{instance=~"$instance", disk=~"$disk", disk!="total"} or (truenas_disk_write_ops_per_second{instance=~"$instance", disk="total"} unless on (instance) truenas_disk_write_ops_per_second{instance=~"$instance", disk!="total"})))

panels.title: Disk Busy %
panels.description: Disk utilization saturation. TrueNAS 27 reports aggregate disk I/O only; this then shows one "total" series, and per-disk filters do not apply.

targets.expr: topk(8, (truenas_disk_busy_percent{instance=~"$instance", disk=~"$disk", disk!="total"} or (truenas_disk_busy_percent{instance=~"$instance", disk="total"} unless on (instance) truenas_disk_busy_percent{instance=~"$instance", disk!="total"})))

panels.title: Disk Temperature Over Time
panels.description: Per-disk temperatures over time (0 °C readings = no sensor, hidden).

panels.title: Disk Temperatures
panels.description: Current temperature per disk, hottest first. Disks reporting 0 °C (no sensor) are omitted.

panels.title: Disk Sizes
panels.description: Raw capacity per disk, largest first.

panels.title: Disk Inventory
panels.description: Per-disk capacity, performance, temperature and media type. On TrueNAS 27 the busy/throughput/IOPS columns are absent because 27 reports aggregate disk I/O only; temperature 0 °C (no sensor) is left blank.

panels.title: Disk Identity
panels.description: Disk model, serial number, and bus for each device.

panels.title: Peak Disk Temperature (~5 min max)
panels.description: Per-disk maximum from the aggregated (min/avg/max) temperature query, refreshed on the heavy-query cadence. Catches short spikes the instant reading misses.

panels.title: Rollback In
panels.description: Seconds until pending network changes auto-rollback; N/A when nothing is pending.

panels.title: Interface Link State
panels.description: Link up/down history. Down on an unused port is normal. Colour key: Up = green, Down = grey.

panels.title: Interface Realtime Link State
panels.description: Link up/down from the reporting.realtime event stream. Colour key: Up = green, Down = grey.

panels.title: NVMe-oF
panels.description: NVMe-oF sessions; N/A when NVMe-oF is not configured.

panels.title: SMB Conns
panels.description: Active SMB tree connections (live, from smb.status).

panels.title: Open Files
panels.description: Open SMB file locks (live, from smb.status).

panels.title: SMB1
panels.description: Legacy SMB1 protocol enabled (insecure when on).

panels.title: Service Runtime State
panels.description: Service running/stopped history. Stopped is normal for services you do not use. Colour key: Running = green, Stopped = grey.

panels.title: ImmediateData
panels.description: Active iSCSI sessions with immediate-data enabled.

panels.title: Used Disks
panels.description: Disks currently in use by pools.

panels.title: Service Inventory
panels.description: Service runtime state and boot enablement.

panels.title: DH RL Error
panels.description: DockerHub rate-limit endpoint currently reports an error.

panels.title: DockerHub Rem
panels.description: DockerHub pull requests remaining in current window.

panels.title: DockerHub Limit
panels.description: DockerHub pull limit window total requests.

panels.title: DH Window Left
panels.description: Seconds remaining in the current DockerHub pull-limit window.

panels.title: App Upgrades
panels.description: Apps with a newer chart or package version available.

panels.title: Migrated Apps
panels.description: Apps migrated from the older Kubernetes stack.

panels.title: Img Updates
panels.description: Apps with container image updates available.

panels.title: App Block I/O Rate
panels.description: Read (up) / write (down) throughput per app, from the cumulative block-I/O byte counters.

panels.title: Apps by Container Count
panels.description: Apps with the largest active workload footprint.

panels.title: App State Distribution
panels.description: Current state mix across installed apps.

panels.title: App Container State Distribution
panels.description: Current runtime state mix across app containers.

panels.title: App Inventory
panels.description: App resource footprint, update posture, and exposure summary.

panels.title: AMD ASIDs
panels.description: AMD Address Space Identifiers are supported.

panels.title: VM Memory Allocation
panels.description: VM memory available vs in use.

panels.title: Incus Instance Running State
panels.description: Current running state per Incus instance (container or VM).

panels.title: Outstanding
panels.description: Alerts not dismissed: truenas_alert_count minus truenas_alert_dismissed_count (alert_count includes dismissed alerts).

panels.title: Critical
panels.description: Critical-or-worse alerts (may include dismissed ones). 0 when none; N/A when the exporter is down.

panels.title: Reboot
panels.description: Reboot required to finish pending changes.

panels.title: Dismissed
panels.description: Alerts dismissed in the UI but still present.

panels.title: Abortable
panels.description: Active jobs that can be cancelled.

panels.title: Last Alert
panels.description: Age since the most recent alert occurrence.

panels.title: Alert Count Over Time
panels.description: Outstanding vs dismissed alerts over time.

panels.title: Alert Classes
panels.description: Most common current alert classes (includes dismissed alerts).

panels.title: Running Job Progress
panels.description: Progress of currently running jobs by method.

panels.title: Active Jobs by State
panels.description: Current active job counts split by WAITING and RUNNING state.

panels.title: Oldest Active Job Age
panels.description: Age of the oldest active job in each state.

panels.title: Job Method Detail
panels.description: Active job counts and progress by middleware method.

panels.title: Alert Source and Node Detail
panels.description: Current alert counts grouped by source and by node.

panels.title: Task Enablement Detail
panels.description: Task enablement. Tasks without a description (e.g. snapshot tasks) are labelled by their numeric TrueNAS ID.

panels.title: Cloud Bkp On
panels.description: Enabled cloud backup tasks (0 when none are configured).

panels.title: Boot Changes
panels.description: Boot ID changes seen since exporter start (proxy for reboot count).

panels.title: Reboot Reason
panels.description: A pending-reboot reason is currently reported.

panels.title: Alert Services
panels.description: Configured alert notification services. The exporter labels services by their numeric TrueNAS ID (no display name is exported), so the service type leads.

panels.title: Update & Reboot Status
panels.description: Current update status/available version and any pending reboot reason.

panels.title: 2FA
panels.description: Two-factor auth (disabled is a hardening finding, not an outage).

panels.title: Directory Svc
panels.description: Directory service (AD/LDAP/IPA) state from directoryservices.status. Disabled is a deliberate choice and reads grey; only FAULTED is red.

targets.expr: (0 * max(truenas_directoryservices_status{instance=~"$instance", status="DISABLED"})) or (1 * max(truenas_directoryservices_status{instance=~"$instance", status="HEALTHY"})) or (2 * max(truenas_directoryservices_status{instance=~"$instance", status=~"JOINING|LEAVING"})) or (3 * max(truenas_directoryservices_status{instance=~"$instance", status="FAULTED"}))

panels.title: Dir Faults
panels.description: Enabled directory services reporting a fault (0 when disabled).

panels.title: Pwd Min Len
panels.description: Minimum password length policy. N/A = no policy set (TrueNAS default).

panels.title: Pwd Max Age
panels.description: Maximum password age in days. N/A = no policy set.

panels.title: Pwd History
panels.description: Password history retention count. N/A = no policy set.

panels.title: FIPS Avail
panels.description: FIPS capability is available on this system.

targets.expr: label_replace(max(truenas_local_user_count{instance=~"$instance"}), "category", "Local Users", "__name__", ".*") or label_replace(max(truenas_local_group_count{instance=~"$instance"}), "category", "Local Groups", "__name__", ".*") or label_replace(max(truenas_certificate_count{instance=~"$instance"}), "category", "Certificates", "__name__", ".*") or label_replace(max(truenas_privilege_count{instance=~"$instance"}), "category", "Privileges", "__name__", ".*") or label_replace(max(truenas_keychain_credential_count{instance=~"$instance"}), "category", "Keychain Creds", "__name__", ".*")

panels.title: Certificate Expiry
panels.description: Certificate expiry in operator-friendly relative and absolute forms.

panels.title: Pwd Min Age
panels.description: Configured minimum password age. N/A = no policy set.

panels.title: API Key Expiry
panels.description: Days until each API key expires (negative = already expired).

panels.title: Next BEs
panels.description: Boot environments selected for the next boot.

panels.title: Boot Environment Used Space
panels.description: Bytes used by each boot environment.

panels.title: GPU Host Avail
panels.description: GPUs available to the TrueNAS host.

panels.title: Host & Chassis Identity
panels.description: Static host, system, CPU, chassis, hypervisor, and GPU identity labels.

targets.expr: label_replace(max by (hostname, version, product_type) (truenas_host_info{instance=~"$instance"}), "component", "Host", "__name__", ".*") or label_replace(max by (manufacturer, product) (truenas_host_system_info{instance=~"$instance"}), "component", "System", "__name__", ".*") or label_replace(max by (model) (truenas_host_cpu_info{instance=~"$instance"}), "component", "CPU", "__name__", ".*") or label_replace(max by (model) (truenas_chassis_hardware{instance=~"$instance"}), "component", "Chassis", "__name__", ".*") or label_replace(max by (variant) (truenas_hw_virt_variant{instance=~"$instance"}), "component", "Hypervisor", "__name__", ".*") or label_replace(max by (index, model, vendor, pci_id) (truenas_gpu_info{instance=~"$instance"}), "component", "GPU", "__name__", ".*")

panels.title: Failover Disabled Reasons
panels.description: Reasons HA failover is currently disabled.

panels.title: Failover Node Reboot Required
panels.description: Failover nodes with a documented reboot-required reason.

panels.title: Directory Svc
panels.description: Directory service (AD/LDAP/IPA) state from directoryservices.status. Disabled is a deliberate choice and reads grey; only FAULTED is red.

targets.expr: (0 * max(truenas_directoryservices_status{instance=~"$instance", status="DISABLED"})) or (1 * max(truenas_directoryservices_status{instance=~"$instance", status="HEALTHY"})) or (2 * max(truenas_directoryservices_status{instance=~"$instance", status=~"JOINING|LEAVING"})) or (3 * max(truenas_directoryservices_status{instance=~"$instance", status="FAULTED"}))

panels.title: Directory Service Type
panels.description: Configured directory service type (always 1 when configured).

panels.title: Directory Service Status
panels.description: Directory service status. service="none" with status DISABLED means no directory service is configured (healthy flag 0 is expected then).

panels.title: System Identity
panels.description: Static system identity labels: global/host ID, product type, current state, version, and system dataset pool.

targets.expr: label_replace(truenas_system_global_id{instance=~"$instance"}, "field", "Global ID", "__name__", ".*") or label_replace(truenas_system_host_id{instance=~"$instance"}, "field", "Host ID", "__name__", ".*") or label_replace(truenas_system_product_type{instance=~"$instance"}, "field", "Product Type", "__name__", ".*") or label_replace(truenas_system_state{instance=~"$instance"}, "field", "State", "__name__", ".*") or label_replace(truenas_system_version{instance=~"$instance"}, "field", "Version", "__name__", ".*") or label_replace(truenas_systemdataset_pool{instance=~"$instance"}, "field", "System Dataset Pool", "__name__", ".*")

panels.title: Dataset Snapshot Counts
panels.description: Datasets with the most snapshots. Partial on TrueNAS 27: per-dataset counts cost one API call each, so the exporter fills at most DATASET_SNAPSHOT_FALLBACK_LIMIT datasets (default 25). See 'Snapshots' on the Pools tab for the total.

panels.title: Dataset Compression Ratio
panels.description: Compression ratio per dataset (1.00 = no savings).

panels.title: Datasets Using Snapshot Space
panels.description: Datasets consuming the most space in snapshots.

panels.title: Dataset Capacity Detail
panels.description: Detailed dataset capacity, encryption, quota, and snapshot info.

targets.expr: 100 * max by (dataset) (truenas_dataset_used_bytes{instance=~"$instance", dataset=~"$dataset"}) / clamp_min(max by (dataset) (truenas_dataset_used_bytes{instance=~"$instance", dataset=~"$dataset"}) + max by (dataset) (truenas_dataset_available_bytes{instance=~"$instance", dataset=~"$dataset"}), 1)

panels.title: Dataset Policy Detail
panels.description: Dataset encryption, policy flags, quota thresholds, and age.

panels.title: Exporter Up
panels.description: Exporter can reach the TrueNAS API.

panels.title: Methods OK
panels.description: Share of API methods whose latest scrape call succeeded (not a call-level success rate).

panels.title: API Err 1h
panels.description: API call errors in the last hour; returns to 0 after recovery.

panels.title: Coll Err 1h
panels.description: Collector errors in the last hour; returns to 0 after recovery.

panels.title: Scrape Age
panels.description: Seconds since the last scrape attempt; check Exporter Up for success.

panels.title: Alert Age
panels.description: Age of the oldest active alert.

panels.title: BE Next
panels.description: Boot environments selected for the next boot.

panels.title: ARC Reqs/s
panels.description: Total ARC demand accesses per second.

panels.title: Data IO Hit
panels.description: Demand-data I/O hits (prefetch in flight) ÷ demand-data accesses, from rates.

panels.title: Meta IO Hit
panels.description: Demand-metadata I/O hits ÷ accesses, from rates.

panels.title: L2ARC Miss
panels.description: L2ARC misses ÷ accesses, from rates. N/A without L2ARC traffic.

panels.title: Exporter & Event Stream Health
panels.description: Telemetry collection health (collector errors shown as a rate, not a lifetime total).

panels.title: API Method Success
panels.description: Latest success flag per API method, failures first. Replaces an unreadable per-method timeline (D4).

panels.title: Advanced ZFS Ratios
panels.description: ARC/L2ARC percentages computed from realtime rates (hits or misses ÷ accesses). The upstream *_ratio fields are not used: 27.0 RC.1 sends 0.

panels.title: Advanced ZFS Access & Miss Rates
panels.description: Advanced demand and L2ARC activity rates.

panels.title: Exporter Version
panels.description: Exporter build version label currently active per instance.

panels.title: Boot Environment Flags
panels.description: Current, next-boot, and retention flags for rollback planning.

panels.title: API Method Detail
panels.description: Per-method duration, success flag, and errors.

panels.title: Generic Event Field Extraction
panels.description: Fallback per-event-field values extracted for undocumented event payload fields (path identifies the field).

panels.title: Generic Method Field Extraction
panels.description: Fallback per-method-field values extracted for undocumented API method result fields (path identifies the field).

targets.expr: label_replace(truenas_method_boolean_value{instance=~"$instance", method=~"$method"}, "kind", "boolean", "__name__", ".*") or label_replace(truenas_method_numeric_value{instance=~"$instance", method=~"$method"}, "kind", "numeric", "__name__", ".*") or label_replace(truenas_method_list_length{instance=~"$instance", method=~"$method"}, "kind", "list_length", "__name__", ".*") or label_replace(truenas_method_status_value{instance=~"$instance", method=~"$method"}, "kind", "status", "__name__", ".*")

panels.title: Event Last Message Age
panels.description: Seconds since the last message was received for each subscribed event.

panels.title: Generic Series Budget Usage
panels.description: Generic series retained; each source has its own MAX_GENERIC_SERIES budget.

panels.title: Generic Series Limit Hits
panels.description: Extraction branches omitted at the configured budget. Descendant samples are not counted individually.
